articles.summary: When people talk about what keeps aircraft on the ground, the conversation usually goes straight to engines or avionics. Pneumatic components rarely come up — which is strange, because bleed air systems, environmental control systems, and anti-ice systems touch almost every major function on the aircraft, and when a single valve or air cycle machine fails, the effect on dispatch reliability is the same as any other AOG event.
